integrity: Analytical proof includes both directions and rebalancing uniqueness; exact-rational checks are corroboration, not a proof for unbounded sizes.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two positive-cost preselected projects, equal endowments and full financing in each order; no extension asserted to partial financing, more than two projects or heterogeneous endowments. Possible unindexed commutativity literature remains a novelty risk.
title: Laminar supporter sets exactly characterize order-robust two-project MES-Style preallocation
